annotations.title: Get China AI US List Crosswalk

description: Read the curated crosswalk from CAC filer legal names to the US Entity List and Treasury NS-CMIC list. Search by Chinese or English entity-name substring; tier defaults to A. Tier A has published evidence for a legal-entity match. Tier B is a possible match, not confirmed, and is outside headline counts. Each entry gives the list name, start date, evidence type and text, and matching CAC record IDs. The Entity List imposes export-licence requirements for specified items subject to the EAR; the NS-CMIC investment ban covers specified US-person purchases or sales of publicly traded securities. These are different restrictions, not generic sanctions. The separate US actions timeline includes the DHS DeepSeek order with Federal Register links. MORVS does not determine whether any CAC DeepSeek filer is the company named by DHS. Not being on either US list never means an entity is cleared.

tier.description: Crosswalk tier: A confirmed, B possible or all; defaults to A.
